basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Birmingham, UK, with a passion for retro gaming and emulation. I work as an IT support specialist during the day, which allows me to dive into my interests during off-hours. I'm single and often browse Reddit in the evenings and late nights. I enjoy helping others troubleshoot tech issues and have a soft spot for classic Nintendo games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught with a focus on emulation and retro gaming, coupled with formal training in IT support. I spend a lot of my free time watching tutorial videos and reading forums to solve tech problems.
